input.quote: (d) Except for the Charges set forth above, there shall be no additional fees payable by the Licensee to the Licensor for technical support services pursuant to this Agreement, unless the parties agree to the contrary in writing.
input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation or pricing-parity language runs against us. Searches for "favorable/favourable", "most favored nation", "best", "lowest", "parity", "discount", "match" and "terms offered" returned nothing relevant, and the commercial terms (Article V fee bands at p0056-p0067, Supplemental Payments at p0078-p0083, and the support/fee provisions at p0086-p0089) are fixed-rate or revenue-share obligations, not an obligation for Licensee to extend Licensor terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers. The only "other licensees" reference (p0094) obliges Licensor to make Revisions available to us when generally released, which is in our favour. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer); an MFN in our favour is a nice-to-have and not demanded, so no redline is proposed.
